name: New Hire
description: First appointment or entry to the company

name: Promotion
description: Movement to a higher role or position with added responsibilities

name: Transfer
description: Movement to another department or branch, same or similar level

name: Demotion
description: Movement to a lower position due to performance or restructuring

name: Reassignment
description: Change of position or location without change in rank

name: End of Contract
description: Employment ended due to completion of contract period

name: Regularization
description: Conversion from probationary to regular status

name: Separation
description: Voluntary or involuntary termination from employment
